ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 65% high-intensity (white) and 35% low-intensity (black) pixel coverage on the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central low-intensity (black) region originating at the peduncle junction, extending more extensively into the inner right lobe. High-intensity (white) pixels dominate the distal regions, interrupted by scattered low-intensity linear and point-like clusters.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with an approximate internal angle of 50 degrees at the central axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration pattern along the entire trailing edge; right lobe exhibits higher amplitude peaks and deeper valleys compared to the left lobe boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge curvature tapering to sharp, high-contrast terminal tips on both the left and right lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Isolated low-intensity circular clusters (approximately 5-10 pixels in diameter) scattered across the high-intensity white regions of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: High-density of multi-directional, dark-pixel linear disruptions (rake marks) crossing the white-pigmented areas of both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Deep, irregular indentations on the trailing edge of the right lobe suggesting prior tissue loss; extensive linear rake-mark scarring across both ventral lobes.
